title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Time Series Analysis

claim.summary: Hierarchical routing selects task-specialized, instruction-tuned SLMs; differentiable prompt pools retrieve historical temporal patterns.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; Anomaly detection and diagnosis; imputation; time series classification

modules.name: Task-specific PEFT and direct preference optimization
modules.scope_reason: The paper updates SLM parameters for temporal tasks; this is model adaptation, not generic runtime optimization.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "We perform instruction-tuning"

modules.name: ReAct master-agent routing
modules.scope_reason: Routing queries to independently specialized agents is domain-independent orchestration; subagents are distinct from their trained models.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "The master agent for sub-agent"

modules.name: Differentiable temporal prompt-pool conditioning
modules.scope_reason: The pool supplies continuous prompt embeddings, concatenated with the numerical input and projected by a learnable W; this is a differentiable model-facing adaptation, not an external episodic store. Move to LLM.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "The dynamic prompting approach"
PDF p.3; Section 3.1, equation projecting concatenated prompt and temporal embeddings
